Page | 1  
 
Assam Schedule VIII, Form No. 127 
High Court Criminal Form No. (M) 106 
ORDER SHEET 
IN THE COURT OF CHIEF JUDICIAL MAGISTRATE, SEPPA, EAST KAMENG DISTRICT, 
ARUNACHAL PRADESH 
 
Crl. Miscellaneous application No. 36/2025 
Under Section 146 BNSS, 2023 
In 
 CR/ Maint. Case No. 12/2020 
Shri Moye Singhi -vs- Smti. Meje Mangkhya 
Date 
Order 
Signature 
 
03.12.2025 
 
The applicant is represented by his learned counsel Mr. 
Sunday Lingfa. 
Respondent Smti Meje Mangkhya is present.  
Heard the respondent in person who admitted that she 
is already married and her maintenance can be discontinue, 
however, she pleaded for maintenance of her child who is 
staying with the relatives of the petitioner (ex-husband). 
Hence, the matter may be referred to Lok Adalat.  
List the case on 13.12.2025 before National Lok Adalat. 
Issue notice to the applicant and the respondent.  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
(Damge Niri) 
CJM, Seppa
